title: RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, usually called RAG, combines information retrieval with language generation. A retriever first finds relevant information and that context can then be supplied to a language model.

title: Vector Databases
content: A vector database stores numerical vector representations of data. RAG systems often use vector databases to find documents whose embeddings are similar to the embedding of a user's question.

title: Embeddings
content: Embeddings are numerical representations of text, images, or other data. Texts with similar meanings are often located near each other in embedding space.

title: Cosine Similarity
content: Cosine similarity compares the direction of two vectors. It is commonly used in information retrieval to estimate how similar a query vector is to a document vector.

title: Python
content: Python is a popular programming language for artificial intelligence, data science, automation, machine learning, natural language processing, and RAG applications.
